title: MAGIC: Mixed-Granularity Agent Graphs via Incremental Construction with Dense-Reward Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.26667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaboration topology shapes both the performance and execution cost of LLM-based multi-agent systems. Because tasks differ in complexity and required capabilities, recent approaches generate task-specific collaboration graphs that specify agent participation and information flow. However, representative topology generators use either individual agents or predefined groups throughout an organization, overlooking differing collaboration needs across subtasks. Our key insight is to select granularity locally for each functional role, combining fine-grained control with reusable collaboration patterns within one organization. Learning such organizations requires exploring a combinatorial construction space with limited intermediate feedback from final-answer rewards. translated_title: MAGIC：基于增量构建与密集奖励强化学习的混合粒度智能体图
translated_abstract: 协作拓扑结构决定了基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的性能与执行成本。由于任务在复杂度和所需能力上各不相同，近期的方法会生成任务特定的协作图，以指定智能体的参与方式和信息流。然而，代表性的拓扑生成器在整个组织中要么使用单个智能体，要么使用预定义的智能体组，忽略了不同子任务之间协作需求的差异。我们的核心洞察是为每个功能角色局部地选择粒度，从而在同一个组织内结合细粒度控制与可复用的协作模式。学习这样的组织需要在组合式的构建空间中进行探索，而来自最终答案奖励的中间反馈十分有限。因此，我们提出了MAGIC，一个用于混合粒度图生成的密集奖励强化学习框架。具体而言，MAGIC构建了一个混合粒度的智能体图（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MAGIC提出了一种基于密集奖励强化学习的框架，通过为每个功能角色局部选择粒度来增量构建混合粒度的智能体协作图，从而在多智能体系统中同时兼顾细粒度控制与可复用的协作模式。
en_tdlr: MAGIC is a dense-reward reinforcement learning framework that incrementally constructs mixed-granularity agent graphs by locally selecting granularity for each functional role, balancing fine-grained control with reusable collaboration patterns in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
